summary: Backend regression-only check for Iter 92.23.11 (frontend-only iteration: FAB Drawer page-context auto-pre-select + Dashboard FolderWorkspaceCards). Per main agent's note, backend code was NOT modified — only ran the 41-test regression covering 92.23.7 (folder CRUD + linking), 92.23.8 (chat folder context + session filter), and 92.23.9 (folder briefing + public sharing). RESULT: 41/41 PASS in 160.71s against https://command-center-229.preview.emergentagent.com. Briefing endpoint (gpt-4o-mini LLM, paid) still returns valid output for owned + empty folders; share endpoint still idempotent; public GET share/{slug} still no-auth and PII-scrubbed; chat folder_context_used flag still set for owned folders. No new tests written (frontend iteration). No backend issues found. Frontend not tested per testing_type='backend only'.
critical_code_review_comments: No new backend code in this iteration — open code-review items from Iter 92.23.9 still stand (see iteration_92_23_9.json lines 12-17): orphan folder_shares on folder DELETE, no unique index on folder_shares.slug/(folder_id,user_id), hardcoded gpt-4o-mini in briefing endpoint with no fallback, build_folder_timeline silently drops item_type='note'. None are blockers for this iteration.

Frontend file FloatingWladBotDrawer.js, FolderWorkspaceCards.js, wladbotBus.js, VideoChallengePage.js, ChatPage.js, DashboardPage.js were NOT reviewed in detail since testing_type='backend only'. Main agent confirms end-to-end browser screenshots show all 3 acceptance criteria (dashboard cards, /missions?folder= deep-link pre-selects rail, AUTO pill on FAB) working.

Test file test_iter92_23_8_chat_folder_context.py uses os.environ['REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL'] (hard KeyError if unset) instead of os.environ.get with a fail-fast assert + clear message — minor DX issue, all 3 iter92_23_* test files share this pattern. Workaround: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest. Not a bug, just brittle.
